title: Waymo AV Lifecycle Ecosystem
subtitle: How MCPI, Triage Ops, and Annotators keep the autonomous vehicle system improving

rings.name: Live Operations
rings.description: Real-time monitoring and immediate intervention during active AV trips

zones.title: MCPI Agent
zones.subtitle: Mission-Critical Platform Intervention
zones.description: The first line of response when an AV encounters an edge case or unpredictable situation. MCPI Agents monitor live trips, evaluate sensor feeds, and decide whether to intervene or let the system self-resolve.

incidents.title: Construction Zone Flagger
incidents.description: An AV encounters an unexpected human flagger at a construction site not in the HD map. The vehicle stops and waits. MCPI must assess whether this is safe to self-resolve or requires escalation.

rings.name: Response Operations
rings.description: Downstream analysis, routing decisions, and data labeling that improve the AV system over time

zones.title: Triage Ops
zones.subtitle: Incident Routing & Prioritization
zones.description: Triage Ops receives escalated incidents from MCPI and decides how to classify and route them. Their routing decision determines whether an incident goes to Annotators for labeling, back to AV R&D, or is closed.

incidents.title: Construction Zone Flagger — Routing Decision
incidents.description: The escalated incident from MCPI arrives in the Triage queue. Triage Ops must classify the event type, assign severity, and route it to the right downstream team.

zones.title: Annotators
zones.subtitle: Data Labeling & Ground Truth
zones.description: Annotators receive routed incidents and create precise labeled datasets. Their work trains the perception models that prevent future edge cases. Accurate labels close the learning loop.

incidents.title: Construction Zone Flagger — Annotation Task
incidents.description: Annotators receive the flagged video clip and sensor data from Triage. They label the flagger's position, gestures, and the zone boundary to create training ground truth.
